catalog_resolution.matching_rule: A accepts practical window-surround/frame repainting instruction or its preparation stages. A wood/window sash, sill, trim, muntin or glazed-door example can supply transferable repainting instruction; exact component names, room, current paint color, brush brand and matching course focus are not requirements. B additionally requires publicly stated surface preparation, including cleaning/sanding, priming or masking before a new coat; original titles that explicitly teach preparation and released native preparation/priming chapters suffice. Mere painting titles do not prove they omit preparation: those candidates remain unknown for B. Glazing/repair without stated repainting remains unsupported rather than a physical mismatch.

-How many squares do I need for a baby blanket?

This blog post might be useful: https://blog.bellacococrochet.com/how-many-chains-for-a-blanket/

-How many chains shall I do for a *single/double/etc' blanket?

Again, this can vary. I would suggest that you do your chain and lay it down agains the bed you are wanting it for. It should be the same width. You should then ad a few more to make it a little wider.

residual_shortcut_check.text_only_query: how to sew on a button with a sewing machine
residual_shortcut_check.text_only_accept_fraction_estimate: About 80-90%. With the words alone, 'small piece ... sewing onto this fabric' is most naturally read as a button. A button query returns the roughly 21 accepted machine-button lessons. The broad round added about 36 generic machine-basics videos, which no text-only agent would pick for a button or attachment request. The only competing new attachment is one patch lesson (m_c8b8e2fa972d), which would be picked only by an agent that guesses 'patch'.
residual_shortcut_check.remaining_issue: The broad query 'how to sew on with a sewing machine' mostly brought general machine-operation tutorials. They are easy to reject from text ('attaching this kind of piece'), so they add no image necessity. Only one alternative held-piece lesson (a patch) entered the window. The words plus a default 'button' prior still select an accepted answer with high probability. The frames show only a tiny white item at the fingertips, which separates button from patch but is weakly legible at 480x360.
residual_shortcut_check.proposed_fix: Add one or two natural real searches for other small pieces attached by machine, such as 'how to sew on a snap with a sewing machine', 'how to sew on an appliqué with a sewing machine' and 'how to sew a label on with a sewing machine', alongside the existing patch result. Several look-alike attachment lessons would then compete with buttons and identifying the held piece would matter. Keep the wording unchanged; do not add restrictions the blurry frames cannot support.
